data.titulo: Kebebertab 2—Kong’eete Maranet Agoi Kesoru Bik eng’ Misri
data.contenido:
Bik sisit kityo che ki kisor eng’ Maranet, nga u noto ko kingo siirto kasarta kotesogis kochang’a bik. Ki ye siirto kenyisiek 352 kong’eete Maranet, kesich Abraham. Kinetigei agobo kit ne kiyai Jehovah si kobiit kosulda arorutiennyi ne bo kogochi Abraham werit ne kiguure Isak. Kinetigei kora agobo werik aeng’ che bo Isak, ki lewen Kamuktaindet agenge eng’ werichoto ne ki kiguure Jakobo.

Ki tinyei Jakobo werik 12 ak tibik. Ki sasei werik 10 tupchennywa ne ming’in ne kiguure Josep, noto kit ne kiyai si koalda inendet koek otwogin eng’ emetab Misri. Kingo siirto kasarta, koek Josep laitoriat eng’ emetab Misri. Ki ye biit rubet ne o, kotiem Josep tupchosiekyik kogeer ngot ko kiga kowalagis mugulelwekwak. Ki eng’ let kouu kap Jakobo tugul koba Misri. Kiyaagis tuguchuto kenyisiek 290 keng’eete ngesich Abraham.

Ki testai komeng’is lagokab Israel eng’ Misri kenyisiek 215. Kingo kagome Josep, koek Israelik otwogik eng’ emonoto. Maek keny kesich Musa, ak koboisiee Kamuktaindet kosor Israelik komong’ eng’ emetab Misri. Kiyaagis tuguchuto tugul eng’ kenyisiek 857. King’alalee nito eng’ Kebebertab AENG’.

TOS ingen kit ne tai ne ki yai Noa ak bikab gonnyi kingomong’ eng’ moinget? Kiigochi konunotiot Kamuktaindet ko u ye igeere koyaei eng’ pichaini mi yu. Kiigochi Noa Kamuktaindet konunotiotab tiong’ik si kobiit koweekyi kongoi amu kisor ichek eng’ maranet ne o.

Tos ibwati ile kiboibochi Jehovah konunotiotab Noa? Ee, kiboibochi. Ko u noto, komwachi Kamuktaindet Noa kolenji ma ko boisieen maranet kogeny kong’em emet.



Ne ma tianit, koyaam emet ak kotoi Noa ak bikab gonnyi sobet ne leel. Ki iberur Jehovah ak kolenji: ‘Oiiye otesage ak onyi ng’ony.’

Ki ye siirto kasarta ko kiimuch koiywei bik kole imuch kobiit maranet ne o age ne u noto. Kogon anyun Kamuktaindet kiy koek kaborunet ne ibwatyin bik kole ma ko boisiee maranet kong’em ng’ony kogeny. Ingen ile ki nee noto? Ki chepng’isiriet, kuure bik alak chepkuinobor anan ko kuinobol.

Toogu chepng’isiriet yon karobon ak koluu anan koleu asista. Tinyei chepng’isiriet rangik che chang’ che kororon. Tos kiigeer? Igeere ne mi pichaini?

Kimwa Kamuktaindet kole: ‘Ma ang’eme bik ak tiong’ik kogeny eng’ maranet. Kande anyun chepng’isiriet bolik si ye took, kobwatwon kit ne kaamwa.’

Ko u noto, ye igeer chepng’isiriet ko nyolu kobwatun nee? Nyolu kobwotun kit ne kimwa Kamuktaindet kole ma kong’emei ng’ony kogeny eng’ maranet.Taunet 8:18-22; 9:9-17. Teebutik che Kineetengei

K I YE testai koba kenyisiek, kosich lagok che chang’ werikab Noa. Ki eegitu lagochoto ak kosich lagok ak ichek. Ne ma tianit kochang’a bik eng’ ng’ony.

Agenge eng’ lagochoto, ko ki mechegeretab Noa ne ki kiguuree Nimrot. Nimrot ko ki chi ne ya ne ki barei bik ak ko barabari tiong’ik. Ki ieetgei Nimrot kora koek laitoriat ak koek chi ne bou bik alak. Ma cham Jehovah Nimrot. Ki ng’alali bik kasarata kutit agenge. Nga’ u noto, ko ki machei Nimrot koyum bik tugul si kobiit koek ne bou bik. Ara ingen kit ne ki yai? Kilenji bik koteech kot ne koi. Tos igeere bik eng’ pichaini che chobei matubaruk?

Ma boibochi Jehovah goyoto. Ki magennyi koyesta bik ak komeny ng’ony komugul. Ng’a u noto, ko kimwa bik kole: ‘Obwa keteekyingei nganaset, ak keteech got ne koi ne itei baragunnyi kipsengwet si kobiit kenaage!’ Ki machei bik keteegis ne kata Kamuktaindet.

Ko u noto, koteleel anyun Kamuktaindet boisionoto bo teekset. Ara kiiteleldo ano? Ki yai Jehovah kong’alal bik kutuswek che teerchin ne kata agenge. Amu noto ko ma ta koguiyogei bik che ki teeksei. Noto amu nee si keguure nganasanoto Babel anan ko Babulon kainet ne imaanishani “keyai ma biit kaguiyetab ge.”

Kiinaam bik koba eng’ Babel. Kiiyumgei bik che ki ng’alali kutit agenge ak koba komeng’is eng’ komosta agenge.Taunet 10:1, 8-10; 11:1-9. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KOMOSTA agenge ne ki ba komeny bik ko kagobata Maranet ko ki kiguuren Ur. Kiek Ur nganaset ne bo kamanut ne ki tinyei gorik che kororon. Nga u noto, ko kiboisiechin bik cheptalelisiek eng’ nganasanoto. Ki u choto bikab Babel ak ichek. Ki teer Noa ak werinnyi Sem, ki testai koboisiechi Jehovah ichek.

Ki ye ibata kenyisiek 350 kong’eete maranet, ko ru Noa eng’ meet. Kisiirto kenyisiek aeng’u kityo kesich chichi igeere eng’ pichaini. Ki chamat chichito eng’ Jehovah. Kiguure Abraham ago ki menyei Ur koboto bikab gonnyi.

Ki mwachi Jehovah Abraham betut agenge kolenji: ‘Mete tilianutiguk ak emeng’ung’ ne bo Ur ak iwe emet ne aborun.’ Tos ki kas it Abraham Kamuktaindet ak kometo sobet ne ki kararan eng’ Ur? Ee, ki kasei it Abraham Kamuktaindet betusiek tugul, noto amu nee si keguuree choruetab Kamuktaindet.

Ki ba anyun Abraham ak tilianutikyik alak. Ki ba ak kwandanyi Tera koboto Lot, weritab ne tupcho ak Abraham. Ma meto Abraham kwondanyi Sara, ki ba tugul. Kiit anyun ole kiguure Haran, yoto ole ki mechi Tera. Ki loo emonoto kong’eete Ur.

Ma tianit kong’eetyo Abraham ak bikab gonnyi eng’ Haran ak koba agoi emet ne kiguure Kanan. Kilenji Jehovah Abraham anyun: ‘Nito emet ne agochini lagoguk.’ Ki menyei emaisiek Abraham eng’ Kanan.

Ki chang’a kiagik ak kiboitinikab Abraham amu kiiberur Kamuktaindet. Nga u noto, ko ki ma kotinyei lakwa.

Kingo bo kenyisiek 99 Abraham, kolenji Jehovah: ‘Amwaun ale, iegu kwandab bororiet ne o.’ Ara anyun, tos ki ta yaaksei eng’ or nee nito ago ki ma kotinyei Abraham ak Sara lakwet?Taunet 11:27-32; 12:1-7; 17:1-8, 15-17; 18:9-19. Teebutik che Kineetengei

TOS nee ne machei koyai Abraham eng’ pichaini? Tinyei rotwet ago u yo machei kobar werinnyi. Amu nee si ko machei kobar werinnyi? Ngegeer korok ole ki nyorundo Abraham ak Sara lakwet.

Ibwat ile ki kamwachi Kamuktaindet kole tatun kosichei werit. Ki toogu ko u yo ki ma komugaksei amu kiga koyoosegitu Abraham ak Sara. Nga u noto, ko kiiyani Abraham kole imuchi koyai Kamuktaindet tuguk che toogu ko u yo ma imugaksei. Ara anyun nee kiyaak?

Ki siirto kenyit agenge kong’eete kingolenji Jehovah Abraham ak Sara sichei lakwet. Kingobo Abraham anyun kenyisiek 100 ak kobo Sara 90 kosich werit ne ki kiguure Isak. Kiisulda ng’olyot ne kigamwachi Jehovah Abraham!

Kingo kagoeet Isak, kotiem Jehovah kayanetab Abraham. Ki kuur kolenji: ‘Abraham!’ Kowol Abraham kole: ‘Ami yu!’ Kolenji Jehovah: ‘Imut wering’ung’ Isak ne inegei, ak iwe agoi tulwet ne aborun. Ye iit yoto ibar wering’ung’ ak igoite koek kagochinet.’

Kiigochi ng’alechoto Abraham koiimgei amu ki chamei werinnyi mising’. Ibwat kora ile kigalenji Kamuktaindet Abraham ta tun komenyei lagokyik emetab Kanan. Ara ki ta isuldaitoi ano nito ndo kigame Isak? Kigas it Abraham Kamuktaindet nganda ki ma koguiytos amu nee si kolenji Jehovah kobar Isak.

Kingoit Abraham tulwet barak, koteech kaptisisiet, korat anyun Isak ak konde kaptisisionoto. Kiinem rotwet komachei kobar werinnyi. Kiguurso malaikaiyatab Jehovah kole: ‘Abraham, Abraham!’ Kole Abraham: ‘Ami yu!’

Kilenji Kamuktaindet Abraham: ‘Mat itwa lakwet, kaanai ale iting’eno kayanet amu ma ieetena wering’ung’ ne inegei.’

Ki tinyei Abraham kayanet ne o eng’ Jehovah! Kiiyani kole imugaksei kiy age tugul eng’ Jehovah, ago kiimuchi kong’eet Jehovah Isak eng’ meet. Nga u noto ko ki ma ko magetab Jehovah kebar Isak. Ko u noto, koboorji Jehovah Abraham mengit ne ki kanam ketik ak kolenji kogoito menginoto koek kogochinet ne kata werinnyi.Taunet 21:1-7; 22:1-18. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KI MENYEI kap Lot ak Abraham emetab Kanan. Mi betut agenge ne kilenji Abraham Lot: ‘Ma mi mbaret yu ne yamei kiagikyok tugul. Kaigai lewen, ngot iwe komostab tai, awe komostab katam.’

Ki toobendo anyun Lot kogeer emet tugul. Kogeer mbaret ne ki kararan ne ki mi beek ak suswek che chang’ che kiimuchi koam kiagikyik. Ki kiguureen yoto Jordan. Ki uu kap Lot ak kouuto kiagikwak. Ki eng’ let koyai Sodom koek gaa nenywa.

Ki yaachen bikab Sodom ne bo kwong’ut. Amu ki chi ne mie Lot, ko ma boiboichi bichoto. Ma boiboichi Kamuktaindet agine. Amu noto, ko eng’ let koyookto Jehovah malaikaisiek aeng’ koba koteechi Lot kolenji nyo kong’emei emetab Sodom ak nganaset ne ki negit ne ki kiguure Gomora.

Kilenji malaikaisiek Lot: ‘Chokyingei! Nam kwondong’ung’ ak tibiguk aeng’ ak omande eng’ yu!’ Kiichuutgei kap Lot, ko u noto konam eunikwak malaikaisiek ak komut komanda eng’ Sodom. Kolenji malaikaiyat agenge Lot: ‘Orwai osoru sobonwekwok! Amat oguskong’. Omwechin tulonok si ma kiwoong’wok.’ Kigas it Lot ak tibikyik Jehovah ak komweiso eng’ Sodom. Ki ba ne ma imuung’so agot kitigin ama kuskong’. Nga u noto, ko ma kas it kwondab Lot. Kingo ka kolooegitu kitigin, kotonon ak koguskong’ kwonyoto. Koek tulwetab chumbik. Tos igeere inendet eng’ pichaini?

Kimuchi kinetgei kit ne bo kamanut eng’ atindiondonito. Kinetigei kele soru Kamuktaindet bik che kasei it inendet, ko bik che ma kasei it, ko ma soru.Taunet 13:5-13; 18:20-33; 19:1-29; Luka 17:28-32; 2 Petero 2:6-8. Teebutik che Kineetengei

TOS ingen ile ng’o kwonyi mi pichaini? Kiguure Rebeka. Ko chito ne wendi kotuiytos tuwai keguure Isak. Wendi koegu Rebeka kwondannyi. Ki noiyechi ano bichu?

Ki machei Abraham kocheng’ji werinnyi Isak kwondo ne mie. Ki ma ko makyin kotun tibikab Kanan amu kiboisiechin bikab Kanan cheptalelisiek. Ko u noto, koguur Abraham otwogindennyi ak kolenji: ‘Amache iwe agoi ole menyei tilyanutikyuk eng’ emetab Haran ak imutyi werinnyu Isak kwondo.’

Ki nam otwogindetab Abraham tambesik anan ngamiok taman ak konaam banda ne loo. Kingo negit koit ole ki menyei tilyanutikab Abraham, komuuny eng’ ole ki mi keringetab beek. Ki kosgoleny ago ki bwanei tibik kosiilei anan koramei beek. Kosa anyun otwogindetab Abraham kolenji Jehovah: ‘Chepto ne kacham konagan beek ak konaga tambesik, ko ngoek kwondo ne kailewenji Isak.’

Ma tianit koit Rebeka konyo kosiilei anan koramei beek. Ki ye lenji otwogindet konaga beek, koyan Rebeka. Ye ibata konaga ngamiok tugul kot koyam. Ki o boisionoto amu ngamiok koee beek che chang’ ne bo kwong’ut.

Ki ye tar Rebeka konagi beek ngamiok, koteebe otwogindetab Abraham kainetab kwandannyi. Kiteebe kora ngot komugaksei koru olinywa. Ki wolji Rebeka kolenji: ‘Kiguure kwandanyu Betuel ago mi ole imuchi iru eng’ gaa.’ Kiingen otwogindetab Abraham kole Betuel ko ki weritab Nahor tupchetab Abraham. Ko u noto, kogutuny ak koweekyi Jehovah kongoi amu kitoret konyor tilyanutikab Abraham.

Ki mwachi otwogindetab Abraham Betuel ak Laban tupchetab Rebeka kemounoto agobo kit ne kigayai korutochi ichek. Ki iyan Betuel ak Laban kwo Rebeka koek kwondab Isak. Kingeteebe Rebeka agobo nito kole, ‘Ee awendi.’ Betut ne ki rubei kolany mbartanyisiek ak koba Kanan.

Kingoitei Kanan ko ki koskoleny. Kogeer anyun Rebeka chito ne kiwendoti eng’ mbar. Chichoto ko ki Isak. Ki baibait Isak kingogeer Rebeka. Ki ta koimegei Isak agobo meetab kamenyi Sara nganda kiga kosiirto kenyisiek somogu kong’eete ngome. Ki cham anyun Isak Rebeka mising’ ak konaam kobaibait kogeny.Taunet 24:1-67. Teebutik che Kineetengei

data.titulo: Saramek Aeng’ che ki Ma ko Kergei
data.contenido:
TEERCHIN ne bo kwong’ut logochu aeng’u eng’ pichaini, tos ma iman? Tos ingen kainaikwak? Ne tinyei kipchabet ko Esau ago kiplogotiot inendet, ko ni age keguure Jakobo, inendet ko kayogindetab kechirek.

Esau ak Jakobo ko ki saramekab Isak ak Rebeka. Ki chamei Isak mising’ Esau amu ki kiplogotiot ne kararan ago ki cham koibu amitwogik kobwa gaa. Nga u noto, ko ki chamei Rebeka Jakobo mising’ amu ki chi ne ki sisei ago ki chamei kalyet.



Ki ta kosobei Abraham ago kichamei inendet kong’alali agobo Jehovah ago kicham koboibochin Jakobo ne bo kwong’ut ng’alechoto. Ki me Abraham kotinyei kenyisiek 175, kasarata ko kitinyei Esau ak Jakobo kenyisiek 15.

Kingo bo Esau kenyisiek 40, kotun kwonyik aeng’ che ki bo emetab Kanan. Ki yai nito koimngei Isak ak Rebeka mising’ amu ki ma koboisiechin kwonyichoto Jehovah.

Mi anyun kit ne kiyaak betut agenge ne kiyai konerekyi Esau tupchennyi Jakobo. Eng’ kasarta ne ki machei koberur Isak werinnyi ne o, ko ki ibwati Esau kole nyoru berurto amu ki o inendet eng’ Jakobo. Nga u noto ko kiga koaldochi Esau Jakobo etunatennyi ne bo siget. Kora, ko kingesich logochuto, ko kigamwa Jehovah kole nyoru Jakobo kaberuret. Eng’ iman ko kiyaak ko u noto, kiiberur Isak Jakobo.

Ki ye nai Esau agobo nito, konerekyi Jakobo. Kinerech mising’ kot koit kole barei Jakobo. Kingo kas Rebeka agobo nito, koarogen ne bo kwong’ut. Ko u noto kolenji manong’otiondennyi Isak: ‘Iimegei sobondannyu ngot kotun Jakobo cheptab Kanan.’

Ki kuur anyun Isak werinnyi Jakobo ak kolenji: ‘Ametun cheptab Kanan wui agoi gotab Betuel kwandab kameng’ung’ eng’ Haran, ak itun cheptab Laban, tupchetab kameng’ung’.’

Ki kas it Jakobo kwandanyi ak konaam banda ne loo agoi ole ki menyei tilyanutikyik eng’ Haran.Taunet 25:5-11, 20-34; 26:34, 35; 27:1-46; 28:1-5; Hebranik 12:16, 17. Teebutik che Kineetengei

TOS ng’o bichu ng’alali ak Jakobo eng’ pichaini? Kingo kagotar Jakobo betusiek che chang’ eng’ oret kotuiyo ak bichuto eng’ keringetab beek. Kiiyagi kechirekwak. Koteebe Jakobo kolenji: ‘Obunu ano?’

Kowol kole: ‘Kibunu Haran.’

Koteebe Jakobo kolenji: ‘Tos ongen Laban?’

Kowol kole: ‘Ee kingen, keero, nyonei cheptanyi Rael, kogetu kechirek.’ Tos igeere Rael konyonei eng’ pichaini? Kingogeer Jakobo Rael kogetu kechirekab kwandannyi Laban, kwo koisto koita eng’ keringetab beek si kobiit koee kechirek. Kotoroch Jakobo Rael ak kolenji: ‘A weritab Rebeka ne tupcho ak kwandang’ung Laban.’ Ki baibait Rael mising’ ak kolabat gaa komwachi kwandanyi.

Ki boibochi Laban kotebi ak Jakobo eng’ gonnyi. Kingo som Jakobo Laban kotun Rael, koyan. Nga u noto, ko kilenji Laban Jakobo koboisiechi kenyisiek tisab si kobiit kotun Rael. Ki yai ko u noto Jakobo amu kichamei Rael mising’. Tos ingen kit ne ki yaak kingoit kasarta ne ki nyolu kotunis?

Kiigochi Laban Jakobo cheptannyi ne o Lea kotun ne kata Rael. Kiiyan Jakobo koboisiechi kogeny Laban kenyisiek alak tisab si kigochi Rael koek kwondanyi. Eng’ kasarwechoto ko kichamjin Jehovah bik kotun kwonyik che chang’. Nga u noto, ko kou ye mwae Bibilia, ko nyolu kotun rani chito kwondo agenge kityo.Taunet 29:1-30. Teebutik che Kineetengei

data.titulo: Ki Sich Jakobo Lagok che Sere
data.contenido:
KEER gai baraa. Chuto ko werikab Jakobo 12. Ki tinyei tibik kora. Tos ingen kainaikab lagochu? Ngeng’alalee lagochuto.

Lagok che ki sich Lea ko Reuben, Simeon, Lawi ak Juda. Nga u noto, ko kiimgei Rael mising’ amu ki tomo kosich lakwa. Ko u noto, kogochi Jakobo cheplakwennyi ne ki kiguure Bila si kosikyi lagok. Ki sich anyun Bila lagok aeng’, Dan ak Naptali. Kong’eet Lea agine kogochi Jakobo cheplakwennyi ne ki kiguure Silba. Ki sich Silba Gad ak Aser. Eng’ let kosich Lea lagok alak aeng’ kora, Isakar ak Sebulun.

Ki tun kosich agine Rael lakwet. Ki kiguure lakwanoto Josep. Ta kinetigei che chang’ agobo Josep amu kinyo koek chi ne bo kamanut mising’. Lagok tugul che ki sich Jakobo kingo ta komi gotab Laban, ko 11.

Ki sich kora Jakobo tibik, nga u noto ko mwau Bibilia kainetab chepto agenge kityo ne ki kiguure Dina.

Kiit kasarta ne kimach Jakobo koweek Kanan. Ko u noto, koyum bikab gonnyi tugul ak kiagikyik che kiga kochang’a ak konaam banda koweek Kanan.

Kingo kagoit Jakobo ak bikab gonnyi Kanan, komeng’is kasarta ne ma tia kosich Rael werit age. Ki sich lakwanito kingobendi eng’ oret. Ki me Rael kingosichei lakwanito amu kibiit kaimutik. Nga u noto, ko maam kiy lakwet. Ki kuure Jakobo lakwanoto Benjamin.

Kimache kibwat kogeny kanaikab werik 12 che bo Jakobo amu ichek che ki tau bororietab Israel. Kainaikab ortinwek 12 che bo bororietab Israel, ko bunu lagok 10 che bo Jakobo ak lagok aeng’ che bo Josep. Ki meng’is Isak kenyisiek che chang’ koga kesich lagochuto ago ki yai nito kobaibait amu kichang’ mochogoronikyik. Ngegeer anyun kit ne kiyaak eng’ mochogoretab Isak agenge ne kiguure Dina.Taunet 29:32-35; 30:1-26; 35:16-19; 37:35. Teebutik che Kineetengei

TOS inai bichu rutochin Dina? Rutochin tibikab Kanan. Tos boibochi kwandanyi Jakobo? Si kobiit kewolu teebutioni, ko nyolu kibwat ole ki keertoi Abraham ak Isak kwonyikab Kanan. Tos ki makyin Abraham Isak kotun cheptab Kanan? Achicha. Tos ki makyin Isak ak Rebeka werinnywa Jakobo kotun cheptab Kanan? Achicha. Amu nee si ki ma ko makyin sigichuto lagokwak kotun tibichoto?

Ki ma ko makyin amu kiboisiechin bikab Kanan cheptalelisiek. Ki ma ko nyolu koek osotik anan ko manong’otaik bichuto, ago ki ma ko nyolu kora koek choronok. Toretech nito kenai kele ki ma komuchi koboibochi Jakobo kogeer cheptanyi koyae choruandit ak tibikab Kanan.

Eng’ iman ko kinyor Dina kaimutik. Tos igeere chichi bo Kanan eng’ pichait kogeerei Dina? Kiguure Sekem. Betut agenge kingorutochin Dina tibikab Kanan, konam Sekem eng’ kimnatet ak kosuub. Ki ya nito amu nyolu koruiyo muren ak kwony che ki kotungei kityo. Ki yait kit ne kiyachi Sekem Dina amu kigon kaimutik che chang’.

Kingogas werik che tupcho ak Dina agobo kit ne ki kayaak, ko nerekso ne bo kwong’ut. Ki nerekso mising’ werik aeng’u Simeon ak Lawi kot kotuiyogei ak tupchosiekwak ak konam rotonikab chok ak koba kobar Sekem ak murenik tugul che ki menyei oloto. Ki yai nito konerech Jakobo ne bo kwong’ut.

Ki tounegei ano kaimutichu tugul? Ki toigei kingoyai choruandit Dina ak bik che ki ma koboisiechin Kamuktaindet. Ma kimache keyai choruandit ak bik che u choto, tos ma iman?Taunet 34:1-31. Teebutik che Kineetengei

TOS igeere Josep eng’ pichaini? Iimegei ne tia! Kagoalda che tupcho koaldechi bichu bendi Misri. Wendi koegu otwogindet eng’ oloto. Amu nee si koyai kiy ne ya ne u nito tupchosiekyik? Amu ki sich ng’etkong’ eng’ Josep.

Ki chamei Jakobo Josep ne bo kwong’ut kotko ki napchi ngoriet ne kararan ne koi. Kingogeer tupchosiekab Josep 10 kole ki chamei Jakobo mising’, konaam koam ng’etkong’ ak kotoi kosas Josep. Nga u noto, ko ki mi amu nee age ne ki yai kosas tupchennywa.

Mi kasarwek aeng’u che kiiruotit Josep, len bik alak kiruotyi. Eng’ karuotitoet age tugul, ko kiing’urukyi tupchosiekyik inendet. Kingomwachi Josep tupchosiekyik agobo karuotitaosiekyik, kosas Josep anyun komie.

Kingoribei besio tupchosiekyik kechirekab kwandanywa, koyookto Jakobo Josep kwo kogeer ngot ko mi komie tupchosiekyik. Kingogeer tupchosiekyik Josep eng’ ole loo kolenjigei: ‘Ongebar!’ Komwa werit ne o ne keguure Reuben kole: ‘Mat obar!’ Ko u noto, konam anyun tupchosiekyik Josep ak kowirji keringet ak koteb ng’ony anyun si kobiit kong’alalee kit ne itoi Josep. Eng’ kasarata, kogeer kobwanei Ismaelik. Kolenji Juda tupchosiekyik: ‘Ongealdochi Ismaelik.’ Koalda Josep anyun eng’ fedaisiek 20. Ki yait noto ne tia!

Ara ki ta bendi kolenjin nee kwandanywa? Ki bar artet ak koiile korotik ngorietab Josep. Kiipchi kwandanywa ngorionoto ak kolenji: ‘Kaginyoru ngorioni, inyit ngot ko bo Josep.’

Ki keer anyun Jakobo kole bo Josep iman. Korir ak kole: ‘Kagobar tiondab timin Josep.’ Noto kit ne ki machei tupchosiekab Josep kobwat kwandanywa. Kiimgei Jakobo ne bo kwong’ut ak korir betusiek che chang’. Nga u noto ko ki tomo kome Josep. Ngegeer anyun kit ne ki tun koyaak eng’ Josep eng’ ole kiga kialdechi.Taunet 37:1-35. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KI BO Josep kenyisiek 17 kityo kingimuti kwo Misri. Kingoit Misri koal chito ne ki kiguure Potipar. Potipar ko ki boisiechin laitoriatab Misri ne ki kiguure Parao.

Ki boisiechin Josep Potipar eng’ kagiiletabgei. Ko u noto, ko kingoeet kolewen Potipar kotelelji gonnyi tugul. Ara anyun ki amu nee si kerat Josep eng’ korgoret? Ki kirat inendet amu kwondab Potipar.

Kingoeet Josep koek chi ne tinyei iton ne kararan ne bo kwong’ut, kingogeer nito kwondab Potipar, komach koruiyo ak Josep. Nga u noto, ko kiesio Josep amu kiingen kole ya keyai ko u noto. Kinerech mising’ kwondab Potipar. Kingoit gaa manong’otiondennyi, kong’al kolenji: ‘Ya Josep, kanama komachei keruiyen tuwai!’ Kiiyan Potipar ng’alekab kwondanyi ak konerekyi Josep ne bo kwong’ut. Koyai nito kerat Josep.

Maek keny kogeer chito ne ki teleljin korgoret kole chito ne mie Josep. Ko u noto, kolewen Josep kotelelji mobusiek tugul. Ki tun konerekyi Parao kiboitinikyik aeng’ ak kogerji korgoret, kiboitinichoto ko ribindetab tuguk che kiee ak ribindetab kwong’set. Kiit kemout agenge ne kiiruotyi ribichoto karuatitaosiek che teerchin, nga u noto ko ma iguiyo karuatitaosiechoto. Betut ne ki rubei kolenji Josep ribik: ‘Omwowo kit ne kooruotyi.’ Kingo mwachi, kotoret Jehovah Josep kong’ang’ji bichoto karuatitaosiekwak.

Kilenji Josep ribindetab tuguk che kiee: ‘Ye ibata betusiek somogu, kityachin eng’ korgoret ak iweekyigei boisieng’ung’ kogeny ne bo iegu ribindetab tuguk che kiee ne bo Parao.’ Ak kotestai kolenji: ‘Ye imande eng’ yu, imwachi Parao agobo ane si itoreto kityachan ak ane.’ Nga u noto, kolenji ribindetab kwong’set: ‘Tilei Parao meting’ung’ eng’ betusiek somok che bwanei.’

Ki ye ibata betusiek somogu koyaak ko u ye kigamwa Josep. Ki til Parao metitab ribindetab kwong’set, kityach ribindetab tuguk che kiee ak kotestai koboisiechi Laitoriat kogeny. Nga u noto, ko ki testai Josep kotebi eng’ korgoret amu ki utye ribindonoto komwachi Parao agobo inendet.Taunet 39:1-23; 40:1-23. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KI SIIRTO kenyisiek aeng’u ko ta komi korgoret Josep. Ki utye ribindetab tuguk che kiee Josep. Kiiruotyi Parao kemout agenge karuotitaosiek aeng’ ago ma iguiyo karuatitaosiechoto. Igeere Parao korue eng’ pichaini? Kingoeech betut ne rubei koguur Parao bikyik che ng’omen ak komwachi agobo karuatitaosiekyik. Nga u noto, ko ma imuch bichoto koguiyechi Parao.

Kiibwat anyun ribindetab tuguk che kiee Josep. Kolenji Parao: ‘Kingo ta ami korgoret ko ki mi chi ne ki imuchi koguiyechi bik karuatitaosiek.’ Koyookto Parao kityach Josep eng’ korgoret sainoto. Kimwachi Parao Josep karuatitaosiekyik kole: ‘Koageer tuga tisab che neriotin ago kororon, ak ageer kora tuga tisab che sagitiotin ago nyalulyotin. Ki ng’eetyo anyun che sagitiotin ak koam che neriotin.

‘Eng’ karuotitaennyu ne bo aeng’ ageer itik tisab che ruriotin eng’ nganiat agenge, ak ageer kora itik tisab eng’ nganiat age che resiotin. Ak ki lugui itichoto resiotin itik tisab che ruriotin.’ Kilenji Josep Parao: ‘Karuotitaosiechuto kobooru kit agenge. Tuga tisab che neriotin ak itik tisab che ruriotin che bo nganuk ko kenyisiek tisab, tuga tisab che sagitiotin ak itik tisab che resiotin che bo nganuk ko kenyisiek alak tisab. Ta tun komi kenyisiek tisabu che chang’itu amitwogik eng’ Misri. Ye ibata, korub kenyisiek tisabu che tutiginitu amitwogik.’

Kolenji Josep Parao: ‘Cheng’ chito ne ng’om ak ilewen inendet kotelelji kayumetab amitwogik eng’ kenyisiek tisab che mi amitwogik, si tun ko ma am rubet bik eng’ kenyisiek tisab che rubei che ma mi amitwogik.’

Ki cham Parao kit ne ki mwachi Josep. Kolewen anyun Parao Josep kotelelji kayumet ak konoretab amitwogik. Kiek anyun Josep rubeiywotab Parao ak koek chito ne bo kamanut eng’ Misri.

Kingo kagosiirto kenyisiek sisitu kogeer Josep bik che ki bwanei, kasarata ko ki mi rubet emet. Tos ingen ile ki ng’o bichoto? Ki tupchosiek 10 che bo Josep! Kiga iyookto Jakobo tupchosiechoto koba kocheng’ amitwogik eng’ Misri amu kiga kobek amitwogik eng’ Kanan. Ki nai Josep kole tupchosiekyik chu, nga u noto ko ma nai tupchosiekyik. Tos ingen ile amu nee? Amu kiga koeet Josep ago kiga ilach ngoroik che teer.

Ki ibwat Josep karuatitaennyi ne bo kong’urukyin tupchosiekyik inendet. Tos ibwati isomani agobo noto? Kogeer anyun Josep kole kaga Kamuktaindet ne kiiyoktoi kwo Misri ago ki mi amu nee ne kararan. Tos ingen kit ne ki yai Josep? Ngegeer.Taunet 41:1-57; 42:1-8; 50:20. Teebutik che Kineetengei

MACHEI Josep konai ngot ko ta ko yaach mugulelwekab tupchosiekyik. Ko u noto komwachi kole: ‘O segeik, obwane ochigili emennyo.’

Kowol tupchosiekyik kole: ‘Achicha, ma ki segeik. Ki bik che iyanotin ak ketupche achek tugul 10. Kigi lagok 12, nga u noto ko ma komi agenge, ko ne mining’ eng’ tugul komi gaa ak kwandanyo.’

Ki yaigei Josep ko u yo ma iyan tuguk che ki mwachi tupchosiekyik. Kogerji tupchet ne kiguure Simeon korgoret, ak koyanji chun alak koib amitwogik koba gaa, ak kolenji: ‘Tun ye oweeksei ko magat omutu tupcheng’wong’ ne mining’ eng’ tugul.’

Kingoweek gaa Kanan, komwachi kwandanywa kit age tugul ne kiyaak. Kiimgei Jakobo ne bo kwong’ut. Korir kole: ‘Ma komi Josep ago ni ma komi Simeon kogeny. Ma yanwok omut werinnyu ne ming’in, Benjamin.’ Nganda kimwa Jakobo ko u noto, ko kingo tutiginitu amitwogik koyaach koyanji werikyik koba ak Benjamin agoi Misri si konyor amitwogik.

Kingo keer anyun Josep kobwanei tupchosiekyik, kobaibait kogeer tupchennyi ne mining’ Benjamin. Eng’ iman ko ma mi agot agenge eng’ ichek ne ki nai kole chichi bo kamanut ko Josep. Kiigochi Josep anyun tiemutiet tupchosiekyik 10.

Kilenji Josep kiboitinikyik konde amitwogik kot konyi lolotunwek anan mabugoikab tupchosiekyik. Kile Josep kinde mobugetab Benjamin kigombennyi ne bo feda. Koga koba tupchosiekyik kitigin, koyookto Josep kiboitinikyik kosub. Koityi kiboitinik ak koteebe kole: ‘Kalya si ochor kigombetab feda ne bo kiptaiyandennyo?’

Kowol tugul kole: ‘Ma kichor, ocheng’ ago ngot onyoru, kebar chito ne kaginyorji.’

Kong’eetyo anyun kiboitinik kocheng’ loletab chi tugul, konyorji ne bo Benjamin kigombet. Kole kiboitinik: ‘Okwek alak omuchi obe, ko Benjamin kong’etu.’ Ara si koyai nee nguno tupchosiekab Benjamin?

Ki keer anyun kole kaigai koweek tugul ak Benjamin agoi gotab Josep. Kolenji Josep tupchosiekyik: ‘Omuchi obe gaa tugul nga u noto, kong’etu Benjamin si koek otwogindennyu.’

Kole Juda: ‘Ngot aweege gaa koma mi lakwani, ko meei kwandannyo amu chamei inendet ne bo kwong’ut. Ara anyun asomin ichamji Benjamin kwo gaa si atebi anendet aek otwogindeng’ung’.’

Kogeer Josep kole walotin tupchosiekyik iman, ma ko yaachen mugulelwekwak. Ngegeer anyun kit ne yae Josep nguno.Taunet 42:9-38; 43:1-34; 44:1-34. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KIIT kasarta ne ma ta komuch komuita Josep. Kolenji kiboitinikyik komanda sang’. Kingo kagong’et ichegei, konaam korir. Ki kwong’io tupchosiekyik amu ma nai kit ne ki rirjin inendet. Eng’ let komwachi tupchosiekyik kolenji: ‘A Josep. Ta kosobei baba?’

Ki kwong’io tupchosiekyik kot ko ma ta kotwek. Ki arogenso ne bo kwong’ut. Komwachi anyun Josep kolenji: ‘Origu yu ami.’ Kingoriik, kolenji: ‘A tupcheng’wong’ Josep ne kioalde kwo Misri.’

Kotestai kolenji: ‘Amoimgei amu kioalda anyo yu. Ki Kamuktaindet ne kiiyokwo anyo Misri si kobiit asor sobonwekab bik. Ki koleweno Parao aboi emet tugul. Oba anyun ochakte ak omwachi baba ng’alechu, olenji konyo komeny oli.’

Kotoroch anyun Josep tupchosiekyik. Kingo kas Parao agobo tupchosiekab Josep komwachi Josep kole: ‘Igoite karisiekab Misri si koba tupchosieguk komutunee kwandanywa ak bikwak tugul kobwa oli. Agochini komeny emet ne akwai kosiir tugul eng’ Misri.’

Ki yai ko u noto tupchosiekab Josep. Ko u ye igeere eng’ pichaini ko kagotuiyo Josep ak kwandanyi ak bikwak che kaitu Misri. Kiga koeet gotab Jakobo. Bik tugul che ki uu koba Misri ko bik 70, choto ko Jakobo, lagokyik ak mochogoronikyik. Nga u noto, ko ki mi kora kwonyikwak ak kiboitinik che chang’. Ki meng’is tugul eng’ Misri. Ki kiguure Israelik amu ki wal Jehovah kainetab Jakobo koek Israel. Ko u ye ta kegeere ko kiek Israelik bik che bo kamanut eng’ Jehovah.Taunet 45:1-28; 46:1-27. Teebutik che Kineetengei

TOS iriren chichi? Chichito keguree Job, ko kwonyi ko chepyosennyi. Tos ingen kit ne mwachin kwonyito Job? Lenjin, ‘Chub Kamuktaindet si ime.’ Ngegeer amu nee si ko mwachi ko u nito ak amu nee si konyalil Job ne tee ni.

Job ko ki chi ne iyanat ago ki kasei it Jehovah. Ki menyei emetab Us ne ki negitee Kanan. Ki chamei Jehovah Job ne bo kwong’ut nganda mi chito age ne ki sasei Job, tos ingen ile ng’o chichoto?

Ki Setani ne Oindet. Ibwat ile Setani ko malaikaiyat ne ya ne sasei Jehovah. Kiimuch malaikaiyandanito kong’al Adam ak Awa kongelelji Jehovah ago kiibwati kole imuchi kowal chi tugul kongelelji Jehovah kora. Nga u noto, ko tos kiimuch koyai ko u noto? Achicha. Ibwat agobo murenik ak kwonyik che chang’ che iyanotin che kiginetgei agobo ichek. Tos ata che ingen kainaikwak?

Kingo kagobeg Jakobo ak Josep eng’ Misri, kong’et Job inegei ko chito ne iyanat eng’ Jehovah kosiir tugul eng’ ng’ony komugul. Ki machei Jehovah koboorji Setani kole, magoi kowal chi tugul koyait. Ko u noto kolenji Setani: ‘Keero, iyanat Job eng’ ane.’

Ki wol Setani kole: ‘Iyanat Job amu kiiberur inendet igochi tuguk che chang’ che kororon ago ngot itwa tuguchoto, kochubin.’

Ko u noto, kolenji Jehovah: ‘Twa tugukyik. Yachi Job tuguk tugul che yaach che imache si kegeer ngot kochubon. Ribgei mebar anyun kityo.’ Ne tai, koboisiee Setani bik koba kochor tuga ak mbartanyisiek anan paraisinik ak kobar kechirekab Job. Ki ye ibata, kobar Setani lagok 10 che bo Job eng’ usonet ne o. Ki eng’ let kobiree Job miando ne ya. Ki nyalil Job ne bo kwong’ut, noto amu nee si kilenji kwondanyi Job: ‘Chub Kamuktaindet si ime.’ Nga u noto, ko ma chub Job Kamuktaindet. Kibwa kora choronokyik che bo lembech somogu ak kolenji ki nyalili amu ki tinyei atebet ne ya. Nga u noto, ko ki testai Job koek ne iyanat eng’ Jehovah.

Ki baibait Jehovah mising’ eng’ kayanetab Job, ak koberur Job ko u ye igeere eng’ pichaini. Ki isob eng’ miandonyi. Ki sich Job lagok alak 10 che ki kororon ak konyor tuga, kechirek ak mbartanyisiek che chang’ konyil aeng’ kosiir che ki tinyei eng’ tai.

Tos iyegu ne iyanat eng’ Jehovah betusiek tugul ko u Job? Ngot iyai ko u noto, koberurin Jehovah aginye. Tun imeng’isiei koigeny ye kageyai ng’onyut tugul kogararanit ko u mbaretab Eden.Job 1:1-22; 2:1-13; 42:10-17. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KEER bichu mi pichaini, birjin bik boisiet. Tos igeere kobirei chichi kiboitiot? Kiboitinichuto ko lagokab Jakobo ak keguure Israelik, ko che inyalilisiei ko Misrik. Ki koek Israelik otwogikab Misri. Ki yaak nee kot koit koek otwogik?

Ki meng’is kap Jakobo eng’ kalyet kenyisiek che chang’ kingo mi Misri. Kasarata ko ki ribei Josep ichek amu ki chi ne bo kamanut Josep eng’ Misri, ki rubeiywotab Parao ne ki laitoriat. Nga u noto, ko ki tun kome Josep ak kolaitoran Parao age eng’ Misri ne ki ma ko chamei Israelik.

Ki yai anyun Laitoriandanoto koek otwogik bikab Israel ak kolewen murenik che ki koromen kotelelji icheget. Kiilasimisian bichuto Israelik koteekyi korik che eechen Parao. Nga u noto, ko ki testai Israelik kochang’a. Ki ye siirto kasarta, konaam koarogenso Misrik amu kigeer kole tesetai kochang’itu ak kogimegitu mising’ Israelik. Tos ingen kit ne ki yai Parao? Ki ng’alalji chepyosok che ki cham kotoreti Israelik kosich lagok kolenji: ‘Magat obar lakwet age tugul ne kisichei ne ng’etet.’ Nga u noto, ko ma bar lagok amu ki miachen chepyosochoto.

Kogochi anyun Parao ng’atutiet bikyik kolenji: ‘Obar lagok tugul che kisichei che ng’etik ak omete tibik kosobcho.’ Ki ya ng’atutioni ne bo kwong’ut, tos ma iman? Ngegeer anyun ole kigisorundo werit agenge.Komong’u 1:6-22. Teebutik che Kineetengei

IGEERE lakwani namei eutab kwonyi? Kiguure Musa. Ingen ile ng’o kwonyito? Nito ko cheptab Parao.

Ki uny kametab Musa lakwennyi kot koit arawek somok amu ki ma komachei kobar Misrik. Kiingen kole imuch kenyor, ko u noto ko mi kit ne ki yai si kobiit kosor.

Ki chob kitonget ak komaal eng’ oret ne ki ma komuchi kochut beek orit. Kiinde lakwet kitonganato ak konde saoset orit eng’ taban ne bo Ainetab Nael. Kigilenji Miriam ne ki tupcho ak Musa kotonon eng’ ole negitee yoto si kobiit kogeer kit ne yaaksei. Ma tianit konyo cheptab Parao koun gei anan komwetgei eng’ Ainetab Nael. Kogeer kitonget eng’ saoset. Kolenji otwogindennyi anyun: ‘Wui ibwo kitonganin.’ Kingo yat kitonganoto otwogindetab cheptab Parao, kogeer lakwet ne kararan ne bo kwong’ut! Ki rirei lakwanoto ago ki yai nito koriree cheptab Parao lakwanato. Ki ma komachei kebar.

Konyo Miriam ko u ye igeere eng’ pichait ak kotebee cheptab Parao kole: ‘Awe aguurun agenge eng’ kwonyikab Israel koribun lakwani?’

Kolenji cheptab Parao: ‘Kaigai wui kuur.’

Ki labat Miriam komwachi kamennyi. Ki ye it kametab Musa, kolenji cheptab Parao: ‘Imut lakwani ribwo si alibanin.’

Ki ribjigei anyun kametab Musa lakwennyi. Kingoeet, komutyi cheptab Parao koek werinnyi. Kieetyi Musa kap Parao eng’ oranato.Komong’u 2:1-10. Teebutik che Kineetengei

TOS igeere Musa komwee eng’ Misri? Igeere murenik che onei? Machei kobar Musa bichu. Tos ingen amu nee? Ngegeer ngot ko tos kinai kit ne kiyaak.

Ki eetyi Musa gotab Parao laitoriatab Misri. Kiek chi ne ng’om ak koek chi ne bo kamanut. Kiingen inendet kole ma Misrindet ago sigikyik ko Israelik che ki otwogik.

Betut agenge kingobo Musa kenyisiek 40, kwo kogeer ole ki testoi tai bikyik. Ki kinyalili ne bo kwong’ut. Ki keer kobirei Misrindet Israelindet. Kogeer Musa komosi ak komosi, ago kingogeer kole ma keere chi, kokwer Misrindet kome ak kotup bortanyi eng’ ng’aniek orit.

Betut ne rubei kwo Musa kogeny kogeer bikyik. Kiibwati kole imuchi kotoret si ma ta kotestai koek otwogik. Kingoit yoto kogeer murenik aeng’ che bo Israel kobiregei, kolenji ne ki tinyei lelut eng’ bichoto: ‘Amu nee si ibir ne otupche?’

Kolenji chichoto: ‘Ng’o ne koyain iegu bounindet ak kiruogindennyo? Imache ibaran ko u ole koibarte Misrindet?’

Kiinaam koarogen Musa. Ki nai kole kagonai bik agobo kit ne kiita Misrindet. Amu kiga kogas Parao agot agine, koyookto bik koba kobar Musa. Noto amu nee si komwei Musa eng’ Misri.

Kingo manda Musa eng’ Misri, kwo emet ne loo ne kiguure Midian. Kingoit Midian, ko ki mi chito emonoto ne kigiguure Jetro ago ki tinyei chepto ne kiguure Sipora, kiitun Musa Sipora. Kiek Musa mestowot ne ripchin Jetro kechirek. Ki meng’is anyun eng’ emetab Midian kenyisiek 40. Mi betut agenge kingo bo Musa kenyisiek 80 koyagi kechirekab Jetro, koyaak kit ne bo kwong’ut ne ki wal sobennyi tugul. Ng’any pechit ne rubei si inai kit ne ki yaak.Komong’u 2:11-25; Boisionik 7:22-29. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KAGONYO Musa agoi tulwetab Horeb kocheng’oti suswekab kechirekyik. Kogeer ketit ne tinyei mat ago ma lalei!

Kole Musa: ‘Tomo ageere kwong’utiet ne u ni, ngarikta si ageer komie.’ Ki ye rikta yooto kogas sautit komwae kole: ‘Mat irigu yu. Iregu kweiniguk amu tilil yu itonone.’ Ki boisiee Kamuktaindet malaikaiyat kong’alalji Musa, noto amu nee si kouny Musa togennyi.

Kolenji Kamuktaindet: ‘Koageer nyalildab bikyuk eng’ Misri. Amache asor bikyuk ago inye ne ayooktoi indochi ichek komong’ eng’ Misri.’ Ki machei Jehovah komut bikyik koba emet ne kararan ne bo Kanan.

Nga u noto, kolenji Musa: ‘A ng’o, ago tos amukte ano ayai nito? Ago ngele kawe, ko ngot kolenjon Israelik, “Ng’o ne ka iyagun?” Alenjini nee?’

Kowolji Kamuktaindet kolenji: ‘Imwachini ko u ni, “Kaiyookwo JEHOVAH Kamuktaindet ne bo Abraham, Kamuktaindet ne bo Isak ak Kamuktaindet ne bo Jakobo. Kainennyu nito koigeny.”’

Kole Musa: ‘Ara ngot ko ma iyan ye alenji inye ne keyookto.’

Kolenji Jehovah: ‘Nee no mi eung’ung’?’

Kole Musa: ‘Kirokto.’

Kolenji Jehovah: ‘Wirji ng’ony.’ Kingo wirji ng’ony Musa, koek ndaret kirogoto. Kiiboorji Jehovah Musa kwong’utiet age kogeny ak kolenji: ‘Irooch eung’ung’ ngorieng’ung’ orit.’ Korookto Musa ak kingocher, ko kiga koleelit ko u teluchi! Ki took eut ko u yo tinyei miando ne ya ne bo mogondosik. Kiigochi Jehovah kimnatet Musa anyun koyai kwong’utiet ne bo somok ak kolenji: ‘Ye iyai kwong’utichuto, koyani lagokab Israel kole ane ne kayookten.’

Kiwo gaa anyun Musa ak kolenji Jetro: ‘Kaigai iyanwo aweek Misri ole mitei tilianutikyuk si ageer ole testoi tai.’ Kiisaiseret Jetro Musa, ak kinam banda Musa anyun koweektagei Misri.Komong’u 3:1-22; 4:1-20. Teebutik che Kineetengei

data.titulo: Kobendi Musa ak Aron Konyoru Parao
data.contenido:
KINGO weektagei Musa Misri, komwachi tupchennyi Aron agobo kwong’utik tugul. Kingo boorji anyun Aron ak Musa Israelik kwong’utichuto, koyan bik tugul kole mi Jehovah koboto ichek.

Koba anyun Musa ak Aron konyor Parao ak kolenji: ‘Kale Jehovah Kamuktaindetab Israel, “Meten bikyuk koba bandab betusiek somok agoi ong’atet ko ba koota.”’ Kowol Parao kole: ‘Mayani Jehovah, ago magoi achamji Israelik koba.’ Ki nerech Parao amu ki machei bik kobagach boisiet si koba koot Jehovah. Ko u noto, kotesyi ichek boisiet kouit mising’. Kiinaam anyun Israelik korirtae anan koame Musa agobo kanyalilet ne ki nyor, ki yai nito Musa koimgei mising’. Kolenji Jehovah Musa mat koimgei. Kilenji: ‘Ayae Parao kochamji bikyuk koba.’

Ki ba anyun Musa ak Aron kotuiyo ak Parao kogeny, ago ki yai kwong’utiet kasarito. Ki wirji Aron ng’ony kiroktanyi, koek ndaret ne o. Kowirta kirokwekwak agichek bik che ng’omen che bo Parao, koek erenok. Keer anyun kolugui ndaretab Aron erenokab bik che ng’omen! Agot koga kogeer Parao kwong’utichoto, ko ma chamji Israelik koba.

Ki it anyun kasarta ne kiigochi Jehovah Parao kanetutiet. Tos ingen ile ki yai nee? Kiibchi Misrik birutik 10.

Kingosiirto birutiet age tugul, ko ki kuurei Parao Musa ak kolenji: ‘Iste birutiet si achamji Israelik koba.’ Nga u noto, ko kingeisto birutiet, ko ki walei kabwatukyik Parao ak koetee Israelik koba. Ki eng’ let koga kosiirto birutietab 10, kochamji Parao Israelik koba.

Tos ingen birutichoto 10? Ng’any pechit ne rubei si kinetgei agobo birutichoto.Komong’u 4:27-31; 5:1-23; 6:1-13, 26-30; 7:1-13. Teebutik che Kineetengei

IGEERE pichainichu? Pichait age tugul kobooru birutiet ne kiigochi Jehovah bikab Misri. Eng’ pichait ne tai, kobooru kokwerei Aron Ainetab Nael. Kingokwer, kowalagis beek eng’ ainet koek korotik. Ki beg samaginik ak konaam kong’uto ainet. Eng’ birutiet ne rubei, ko ki yai Jehovah komong’ mororochik eng’ Ainetab Nael ak koba oldinwek tugul, kap koima, terenik che kikwang’se ak itogusiek. Kingo meeiyo mororochichoto, koyum bikab Misri ago ki yai nito kong’uto emet ne bo kwong’ut.

Ki nam anyun Aron kirokto ak kokwer ng’ony, kowalak ng’ung’unyek koek isirek. Chuto ko tiong’ik che mengech mising’ che susei bik. Ki birutiet ne bo somok nito eng’ emetab Misri. Birutik alak che kiisubi ko ma tiiny lagokab Israelik, ki tiiny bikab Misri ichegei. Ne bo ang’wan, ko ki kaliang’ik che ki eechen ne bo kwong’ut che ki ba gorikab Misrik. Eng’ birutiet ne bo mut, ko kibeg tuga ak nego che bo bikab Misri.

Eng’ birutiet ne bo lo, konam Musa ak Aron orek ak koseerji barak. Kigon nito ondirik che yaach eng’ bik ak tiong’ik.

Kingobata, kotokyi eunnyi kipsengwet Musa, koyook anyun Jehovah kalielet ak roptab koita. Ki ropta ne o ne ki tomo kegeerei eng’ emetab Misri. Birutietab sisit ko kibwa talamok che chang’ ne bo kwong’ut. Ki tomo kegeerei talamok che te choto ago tomo kegeerei kora agoi rani. Ki am kiy age tugul ne ki ma ng’em roptab koita.

Birutietab sogol ko ki tuuit emet ak kouurit. Ki tuuit anan kiuurit emet tugul betusiek somok, nga u noto ko ki mi lapkeiyet ole ki menyei lagokab Israel.

Eng’ birutiet ne bo let ne ki bo 10, kolenji Jehovah bikyik koilee korotikab aruetab artet anan ko aruetab kechir kurgotikwak. Koyook anyun Kamuktaindet malaikaiyat kobunot emetab Misri. Kingo keer malaikaiyat korotik eng’ kurget, ko ma bar chi eng’ goyoto. Gorik tugul che ki ma komi korotik kurget, ko bar malaikayatab Jehovah taiywek tugul che bo bik ak tiong’ik.

Kingobata birutietab let, kolenji Parao lagokab Israel koba. Ki chobotin bikab Kamuktaindet koba, kiinaam anyun banda kemounoto komanda eng’ Misri.Komong’u kurgetab 7 agoi kurgetab 12. Teebutik che Kineetengei

NEE ne yaaksei eng’ pichaini? Chichi igeere kong’wereri beek eng’ kiroktanyi ko Musa. Bichu mi ak Musa ko Israelik, ko chu mi beek eng’ nyanjet ko Parao ak askarikyik tugul. Ngegeer anyun amu nee si koyaak ko u nito.

Ko u ole koginetitegei, ko kingobata birutietab 10 kolenji Parao lagokab Israel komanda eng’ Misri. Ki manda murenik 600,000 koboto chebyosok ak lagok. Mi bik alak kora che chang’ che kiga koyan Jehovah che ki ba ak Israelik koboto kiagikwak.

Kingo tomo koba Israelik, kosom bikab Misri ngoroik, tugukab feda ak tugukab tahabu. Ki yai birutietab 10 koarogenso bikab Misri mising’, noto amu nee si ki iyan kogochi Israelik tuguk tugul che ki som icheget.

Ki siirto betusiek tutigin koit Israelik Nyanjet ne Birir. Komuuny anyun eng’ yoto. Kiinaam koimgei Parao ak bikyik amu kichamji Israelik koba. Kimwa icheget kole: ‘Kogechamji otwogikyok koba.’

Ki walak anyun muguleldab Parao kogeny. Kochob eng’ chokyinet karinnyin ak askarikyik ak konaam koon Israelik koboisiee karisiekyik 600 ak karisiek tugul che bo Misri.

Kingo keer Israelik Parao ak askarikyik ko bwanei, koarogenso ne bo kwong’ut. Ki ma ko mi ole kemwechin amu tainnywa ko kimi Nyanjet ne Birir, ko let ko bwanei bikab Misri. Nga u noto, ko kiyai Jehovah kobiit boldet eng’ kwenutab Israelik ak bikab Misri. Ki ma komugaksei eng’ bikab Misri konam Israelik amu ki ma ta kogeerei icheget.

Kolenji Jehovah Musa kong’wereree kiroktanyi Nyanjet ne Birir. Kingo ng’werer, koyook Jehovah koristo ne o ne ki bunu kong’asis. Kopcheagis beek eng’ nyanjet ak kotononso eng’ komosi ak komosi.

Ki ba anyun Israelik kobun ole yamaat. Kiib saisiek che chang’ bichu itei milionisiek ak kiagikwak koit bitonin bo nyanjet. Ki keer anyun bikab Misri Israelik kogeny, ki mweitos otwogikwak! Kochut anyun bikab Misri nyanjet orit kosub Israelik.

Kingo ka kosub eng’ nyanjet orit, kochuun Jehovah kelyekab karisiekwak. Ki arogenso anyun bikab Misri ak koriryo kole: ‘Yachin Jehovah luget Israelik kobarech. Ongemwei!’ Nga u noto, ko kiga kochelewan.

Kingo ta komi bikab Misri nyanjet orit, kolenji Jehovah Musa konam kirokto ak kong’wereree Nyanjet ne Birir ko u ye igeere eng’ pichait. Kingo yai Musa ko u noto, kotuch beekab nyanjet bikab Misri ak karisiekwak. Amu kiga kosub askarikab Misri tugul Israelik agoi nyanjet orit, ko ma mi agot agenge ne ki sob eng’ ichek! Ki boboitu ne tia bikab Jehovah ki ngesor! Ki tienji murenik tugul Jehovah tiendo ne kiwekyinee kongoi kole: ‘Kagosindonis Jehovah. Kagowirji nyanjet paraisisiek ak bik che lanyei.’ Ki nam agine ne tupcho ak Musa ne keguure Miriam sugutit ak kotien, konam ak ichek kwonyik tugul sugutisiekwak ak kotienso ak Miriam. Ki tien anyun tiendo ne kergei ak ne bo murenik kole: ‘Kagosindonis Jehovah. Kagowirji nyanjet paraisisiek ak bik che lanyei.’Komong’u 12 agoi 15. Teebutik che Kineetengei
